title: QuantifiedSkillOutput
description: Standard schema for machine-readable evaluation blocks emitted by quantified skills.

skill_name.description: The kebab-case identifier matching the skill folder.

version.description: Semantic version of the skill or evaluation standard.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 formatted timestamp of run execution.

sample_size.description: Number of documents, samples, or items evaluated in this run.

status.description: Overall outcome status based on target threshold.

metrics.description: Numeric key-value pairs of metrics produced by the skill.

error_taxonomy.description: Optional breakdown of error counts according to standard error classes.

metadata.description: Optional arbitrary metadata regarding the evaluation context.
